Author-confirmed. The 2px leading edge on a rail row is this project's documented navigation idiom, not a coloured tab on a card: app/globals.css specifies the rows as `grid items-baseline gap-2 rounded-md border-l-2 px-3 py-2.5` with active as `border-cyan bg-cyan/5 text-fg`, and the accounts hand-off restates it under "Components to reuse (do not rebuild)". Four surfaces draw it - Learn, /blueprints/[slug], /nodes/[...id], /settings and the owned-bundle page. Scoped to this file only, so the rule still fires on a card anywhere else.
